diagnosis: HasOrganizationBillingPrivilege only defines has_permission(), checking if the user holds billing privileges within their own account. It omits has_object_permission() and the view uses an unscoped queryset, allowing any user with billing privileges in one organization to view and modify subscription tiers for any other organization.

GET /api/billing/subscriptions/883/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.saas.example
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
